REQUIRED LOGO FILES (add these files before testing/deployment)

1) logo.mp4   Your full-screen intro animation.
              Recommended: MP4 / H.264, muted/no critical audio, landscape
              or square composition with generous breathing room around logo.
              It plays in full, unskippably, each page load.
              Browser restrictions may require visitors to tap to start playback.

2) logo.png   Your static logo; ideally transparent PNG, 1024px or higher.
              Used on the homepage, browser icon and link previews.

Paths must be exactly:
  public/assets/logo.mp4
  public/assets/logo.png

If logo.mp4 is missing or cannot play, the page will show the homepage
rather than leaving the visitor permanently stuck on a blank screen.
